def process(itTheftRaw) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import re

    df = itTheftRaw.copy()

    # Identify header rows per file and keep only plausible data rows.
    # Data rows typically have a metro name in col0 and a numeric count in col1.
    c0 = 'Metropolitan Areas: Identity Theft Reports'
    c1 = 'Unnamed: 1'

    # Drop obvious non-data rows
    df = df[~df[c0].fillna('').str.contains(r'^Source:', case=False, regex=True)]
    df = df[~df[c0].fillna('').str.match(r'^Metropolitan Area\s*$', case=False)]
    df = df[~df[c0].isna()]

    # Keep rows with numeric report counts
    def to_num(x):
        if x is None:
            return None
        s = str(x).strip()
        if s == '' or s.lower() in {'nan', 'none'}:
            return None
        s = s.replace(',', '')
        m = re.fullmatch(r'-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?', s)
        if not m:
            return None
        return float(s)

    df['reports'] = df[c1].map(to_num)
    df = df[df['reports'].notna()]

    # Keep only rows that look like MSA entries (have a state abbreviation after comma)
    df['metroRaw'] = df[c0].astype(str).str.strip()

    return df[['sourceFile', 'metroRaw', 'reports']].reset_index(drop=True)

def process(itTheft2023, metroPop2023) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import re
    import unicodedata

    def normalize_metro_name(s: str) -> str:
        if s is None:
            return ''
        s = str(s)
        s = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', s)
        # Remove common suffixes
        s = re.sub(r'\b(Metropolitan Statistical Area|Metropolitan Area|MSA)\b', '', s, flags=re.I)
        s = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s).strip()

        # Keep only "city and state" portion: usually up to first comma plus state abbr
        # For names like "New York-Newark-Jersey City, NY-NJ-PA" keep the whole pre-comma + state string.
        # We'll standardize punctuation/hyphens.
        s = s.replace('–', '-').replace('—', '-')
        s = re.sub(r'[\(\)\[\]\.]+', '', s)
        s = s.replace('&', 'and')
        s = s.lower()
        s = re.sub(r'\s*,\s*', ', ', s)
        s = re.sub(r'\s*-\s*', '-', s)
        s = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s).strip()
        return s

    it = itTheft2023.copy()
    pop = metroPop2023.copy()

    it['metroKey'] = it['metroRaw'].map(normalize_metro_name)
    pop['metroKey'] = pop['metroRawHtml'].map(normalize_metro_name)

    # Drop empty keys
    it = it[it['metroKey'] != '']
    pop = pop[pop['metroKey'] != '']

    # Deduplicate population keys (keep max pop2023 if duplicates)
    pop = pop.sort_values('pop2023', ascending=False).drop_duplicates('metroKey', keep='first')

    merged = it.merge(pop[['metroKey', 'pop2023']], on='metroKey', how='inner')

    # Filter metros > 1M in estimated 2023 population
    merged = merged[merged['pop2023'] > 1_000_000]

    # Average identity theft reports across all matched metros
    avg_reports = merged['reports'].mean()

    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'avgIdentityTheftReports': float(avg_reports) if pd.notna(avg_reports) else None,
        'matchedMetroCount': int(merged['metroKey'].nunique()),
        'matchedRows': int(len(merged))
    }])
